spanish: Y tomará el sacerdote desde mano de la mujer la minjá de los celos, y balanceará la minjá delante de Jehová, y la acercará al altar.

findings.issue: minjá leaves the common noun H4503 untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun

notes: Priest 3ms, hand, plural jealousies, Jehová, and bring-near to the altar match the tokens.
